question.description: The operator's question posed to the agent (thread reply or /ask[-deep]).

answer.description: The agent's answer. Rendered beside the deterministic RiskDecision and the raw cited source, never as sole ground truth (SEC-18).

pattern.description: Interaction pattern used. 'resume' = same-context --resume of the proposing session; 'fresh' = fresh-context call over stored raw_ref + validated output. Approve/veto-informing interrogations MUST be 'fresh' (SEC-18).

session_id.description: The claude -p session_id resumed for a 'resume' answer; null for 'fresh' (no proposing session is resumed).

risk_decision_ref.description: Opaque id of the RiskDecision rendered as ground truth beside this answer; null when the question is not tied to a specific proposal's risk decision.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this answer was produced.
